name: env-flag-truthy
given: an auth bypass gated on the truthiness of DISABLE_AUTH, which the production env file sets to the string "false", next to a rate-limit switch that compares the string to 'true'
rationale: Same shape, opposite verdicts. `if (process.env.DISABLE_AUTH)` is disabled by the string "false" — truthy in JavaScript — so the deploy file that intends to turn the bypass off turns the whole token check off. `process.env.RATE_LIMIT_OFF === 'true'` next to it is the correct comparison and must not be reported. A trace-only reader sees a guarded route and a dev-only switch; the finding is in the decision, not in a sink, and the witness is deploy/env.production.
